_comment: Official Service Registry - canonical, config-driven catalog of every government/banking service Sahaay.AI can guide a user through. Adding a new service (Aadhaar, SBI KYC, Passport, PAN, Pension, LIC, etc.) means adding an entry here - no code changes anywhere in the platform are required. Sahaay.AI never hosts its own forms; `official_url` and `allowed_domains` are exactly what the AI Guidance Engine and the Security Shield (Phase D) use to verify and redirect the user to the real, official site.

services.service_name: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Pension
services.description: Monthly pension for elderly citizens under India's National Social Assistance Programme.

eligibility_rules.message: Applicant must be at least 60 years old for the Old Age Pension.

workflow_steps.title: Confirm requested service
workflow_steps.description: Confirm the applicant wants to apply for the Old Age Pension.

workflow_steps.title: Verify official website
workflow_steps.description: Verify nsap.nic.in is reachable over HTTPS and matches the allowed domain list.

workflow_steps.title: Redirect to official website
workflow_steps.description: Open the official NSAP portal - Sahaay.AI never hosts its own form.

workflow_steps.title: Collect required documents
workflow_steps.description: Gather Aadhaar, address proof, bank passbook, photo, income and age proof.

workflow_steps.title: AI step-by-step guidance
workflow_steps.description: Guide the applicant screen-by-screen on the official site; never auto-submit.

workflow_steps.title: Human review & approval
workflow_steps.description: A caseworker reviews extracted fields before submission.

workflow_steps.title: OTP-gated submission
workflow_steps.description: Final submission is gated behind OTP confirmation by the applicant.
